color.colorFunction:
var severity = String(data.active_alarm_severity || "").toUpperCase();

switch (severity) {
    case "CRITICAL":
        return "#FF0000"; // Red

    case "MAJOR":
        return "#FF8800"; // Orange

    case "MINOR":
        return "#FFC107"; // Amber

    case "WARNING":
        return "#FFFF00"; // Yellow

    case "NORMAL":
        return "#00CC00"; // Green

    default:
        return "#9E9E9E"; // Grey: unavailable
}
